WEBMIDI FIRMWARE UPLOADER (M-VAVE FM-1)

Do not unplug the USB cable while writing.

Note: GAMMAWAVE/JIANT repurposes user sample flash (USR1–3) to store full songs, chains and FM6 voice banks.

Dual-Core AC791N + HOTRAM active: both CPU cores render the 6 synth tracks + HEARTH/BLAST/PLASMA/FLUX distortions and VOWEL/SCREAM filters in real time. (Hold REC on power-up to force single-core mode).

Connect the USB cable directly to the computer. No probe or Transporter is needed.

Coming from another custom firmware? Return to official V15 first

Writing straight over another custom firmware (Felucca, baudgirl, etc.) can prevent startup. Return to official V15 below first, then install GAMMAWAVE. If your FM-1 already runs official V15, JIANT, or GAMMAWAVE, go right ahead.

Before installing, the installer checks the connected FM-1's firmware automatically.

Before installing (all four, required)
 The FM-1 is connected straight to the computer with a USB data cable (no hub).
 The computer is on mains power and will not sleep; the FM-1 is charged.
 Every other app that uses MIDI (DAW, editor, other tabs) is closed.
 I will not unplug while writing. If it is cut off, I reconnect and press INSTALL again: the update loader finishes the write.
